title: Cachefront Lifespan Simulator and SafeDeploy Playbook for Prefix Keying
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a lightweight, reproducible simulator (Cachefront Lifespan Simulator) and an operational SafeDeploy playbook to safely apply automated prefix cache recommendations. The simulator will model per-prefix hit-rate under different keying, lifespan (expiry) and population assumptions, estimate token-level cost delta for batching + cache changes, and surface risk signals for rollout. Scope: 1) a batchable experiment harness that replays sampled traffic with configurable key canonicalization rules and expiry profiles, 2) an estimator that converts hit-rate shifts into expected cost/latency effects given our batching model, and 3) a SafeDeploy runbook (preflight checks, dry-run shadowing, health gates, staged rollback triggers). This ticket focuses on prefix-level design heuristics (when to split/merge prefixes), lifespan/expiry sweep strategies, and a confidence metric that gates automated apply. Out of scope: changes to on-disk eviction or shard topology; any permanent schema changes to the cache protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can replay a 24-hour sample trace and produce per-prefix hit-rate projections under at least three candidate key canonicalizations
Estimator outputs expected token-cost delta and 90% confidence interval for a proposed expiry change; results correlate with a small production A/B run within +/-15%
SafeDeploy playbook includes preflight checks, a dry-run shadowing mode, staged rollout steps, and automated rollback triggers tied to latency and miss-rate thresholds
An internal dashboard (dev-only) shows projected vs observed hit-rate and cost during canary runs and is linked from the playbook
All work merged to a feature branch with unit tests and an integration test that validates replay determinism for a fixed seed
tasks: Design proto: define input trace schema, canonicalization rule set, and expiry candidate space
Implement replay harness and per-prefix counters with synthetic workload generator
Build cost estimator that combines batching model and tokenization assumptions
Integrate safety gates (health checks, anomaly detectors) into playbook
Create dashboard panels and wire metrics (miss-rate, p95 latency, token cost estimate)
Run staged canary on a non-customer tenant and compare simulator predictions to observed metrics
Document runbook and add step-by-step rollback instructions and owner on-call
